summary: Mobile Infrastructure Corp filed an 8-K disclosing a Fifth Amendment to its credit agreement with Harvest Small Cap Partners entities, extending the facility's maturity from September 30, 2026 to December 31, 2026; the lender is managed by No Street Capital, whose managing member is co-chair Jeffrey Osher, making it a related-party transaction under Item 404. The board also declared monthly preferred dividends: $4.791 per Series A share and $4.583 per Series 1 share, payable October 12, 2026 to holders of record September 27 and September 24, 2026. No acquisition, tender, or strategic event; watch refinancing risk at the new maturity.
